description: Edit a post's title or tags, pin or unpin it within the forum, lock or unlock replies, or archive it.

archived.description: true archives the post, false brings it back to the active list.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

locked.description: true stops members without Manage Threads from replying, false lets them again.

pinned.description: true pins the post at the top of the forum, false unpins it.

tags.description: Replace the applied tags with these.

name: update_forum_post
title: Update forum post
